independentReview: Destructive scope, writer identities, background relocation, failed metadata publication, grouped-log crash recovery and standalone continuation ownership findings fixed and independently rechecked.

previousCI.detail: Desktop repair layout exposed a missing-root/scan result dereference; reproduced locally and repaired. All four corresponding layout scripts pass locally.

notes: Cancellation cleans only exact task-produced files of unfinished jobs; first-task baseline, shared assets and complete separate tasks are protected.
Paused/network-error tasks retain safe resume progress across restart. Old tasks whose output ownership cannot be proved remain visibly retained for manual verification.
Cleanup failures remain retryable with explicit UI reasons; task status IPC omits callbacks and ownership metadata.
Grouped batch child identities and active checkpoint log ownership are durable; completed and old batch snapshots are not overwritten by standalone resume or interrupted startup.
Record-only deletion defaults to local records and excludes files, using actual detail/log source rather than unrelated selected author.
Tests use isolated profiles, temporary NAS and synthetic platform responses; no real user media or NAS data were deleted.
